topic: What are the trade-offs in using additive manufacturing for CTS array fabrication versus traditional methods in terms of deployment cost and scalability?
consensus_response: Additive Manufacturing (AM) offers design freedom, eliminating split block approaches and allowing monolithic complex designs. However, surface roughness introduced by SLA process affects microwave performance, introducing losses and reducing capacity. As CTS array size increases with AM, scalability limitations arise, leading to higher manufacturing costs and complexity. Optimizing material properties or using alternative fabrication techniques can mitigate these limitations but may compromise on other performance metrics.
